description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Compiler' class for the SCSSPHP library. It serves as the core component responsible for parsing, compiling, and transforming SCSS source code into CSS. The class handles environment management, selector evaluation, media and directive compilation, source map generation, caching, and other tasks essential for SCSS compilation. It also manages import resolution and supports various features like at-root rules and @extend functionality.

classes.name: Compiler
classes.description: Core class responsible for parsing, compiling, and transforming SCSS source code into CSS, managing environment stacks, import resolution, source maps, caching, and various compilation tasks.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Deprecated method that compiles SCSS code string into CSS, also handles source map saving.

methods.name: compileFile
methods.description: Compiles SCSS from a specified file path into CSS, returning a CompilationResult.

methods.name: compileString
methods.description: Compiles SCSS source code string into CSS, respecting the provided source path, with caching support.

methods.name: getCompileOptions
methods.description: Returns the current compilation options as an array.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Sets an alternative logger for the compiler.

methods.name: setErrorOuput
methods.description: Deprecated. Sets an alternative error output stream.
